hold_text: Tier-1 work (ml/ promotion-gate READ paths, tests, one CI guard contract) routed for a human merge only because the diff touches ml/**, which check_pr_landing.py's TIER2_PATHS lists, so R5 cannot certify self-landing -- the same routing #13146 (the API half of FIX-CA-20) used. Paths outside TIER1_SURFACE: ml/cli.py, ml/promotion/attribution.py, ml/promotion/live_parity.py, ml/promotion/oos_edge.py, ml/promotion/readiness_report.py, ml/promotion/stage_guard.py, ml/shadow/__init__.py, ml/shadow/drift_retrain.py, ml/shadow/inspector.py. Nothing in the diff is a writer, an order path, a config, a deploy/unit file, or a trader-process module: every changed ml/ line is inside the offline promotion/demotion evidence tooling (gate-check, stage-guard, promotion-readiness, drift-retrain) that runs on the trainer VM.
why: Code audit 2026-09-27, CA-B01, evidence-settled Tier-1 fixes FIX-CA-20/21/22 (docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27.md section 5; verdicts in docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-LEAD.verdicts.json, all CONFIRMED). FIX-CA-20 (PI-20260927-3WM5HADW-0001): gate-check drift, stage_guard drift, attribution n, live_parity n and drift_retrain n read only the ACTIVE shadow log, truncated at every ~25-29d rotation; new ml.shadow.inspector.iter_records_with_archives unions rotated archives (bounded by the window or a 60-day archive look-back, since archives are never pruned); pre-fix 6 failed / post-fix 9 passed in tests/ml/test_shadow_archive_reads.py, including an AST detector that no ml/ function reads one shadow-log path outside an explicit allowlist. FIX-CA-21 (PI-20260927-3WM5HADW-0002): build_cv_config overwrote each manifest's evaluator_config label_horizon=5 / embargo_fraction=0.01 (28 manifests) with 1 / 0.0; now inherits them and a caller may only widen; pre-fix 4 failed / post-fix pass. FIX-CA-22 (PI-20260927-3WM5HADW-0003): a live-stage hold with drift=None and attribution=None carried the same reason as a measured-healthy head; now demote_evidence_state evaluated / partial / not_evaluable, rendered in the readiness report and registered in check_collapsed_states.py; pre-fix 4 failed / post-fix pass.
